what: Verifier prompt makes the perf-flagged LOOSE_CASE the mandatory target of every perf refinement and applies perf_rules.txt only to free-selected regions, but perf_rules.txt bars all cells <=32 tiles and says it overrides any instruction to target one. When the only flagged case is under the floor (g6_repeat p1 = 8 tiles) the two rules contradict and the 2:1 cadence cannot be filled.
suggest: State in the perf-refinements section that the perf_rules.txt tile floor applies to flagged cases too, and that a flagged case below it yields zero perf refinements (record it in the report, leave the queue empty).

what: _poison_tile_padding poisons through ttnn.fill_implicit_tile_padding, which lands 0x7F80 (+inf) for a NaN fill on this build, so poisoned_padding_nan fails its harness precondition before the op runs and can never pass for any implementation.
suggest: Poison via a (...,32k,W) tile tensor with poisoned rows viewed through ttnn.reshape(t, logical, padded) over the same buffer (as tests/ttnn/unit_tests/operations/g6_repeat/test_g6_repeat.py does), or make fill_pad write NaN without passing through DEST.
